title.zh: 雇佣 K 名工人的最低成本
title.en: Minimum Cost to Hire K Workers

desc.zh: 从共同工资单价推导排序与最大堆。
desc.en: Derive a rate sweep and max-heap from proportional pay.

complexity: O(n log n + n log(k+1)) time; O(n+k) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Proportional pay rate sweep
concepts.description: Keep the k smallest qualities among workers admitted by rate.
